thread:
nora: FYI - sudden increase in 502s for embeddings in eu-west1 since 03:40. Triage points to model promotion race that pulled a legacy quantized artifact. Requesting expedited hotfix deploy and approval to bypass standard canary for region-only cutover.

deploybot: Preflight: CI: ✅, E2E: flaky test ignored (9/10), infra checks: ✅. Suggested deploy: ```./deploy --svc embeddings --region eu-west1 --image ghcr.io/redwood/embeddings@sha256:c0ffee11 --expedite```

ops-oncall: Impact: 15% 502 rate on /v1/embeddings eu-west1 over last 12m. No DB changes. Retries causing backlog.

sam: Can we limit to a partial rollout first?

nora: Prefer fast fix: 100% override for eu-west1 only, ops will monitor and rollback on trigger.

deploybot: Emergency policy: requires explicit approval phrase and ops-lead signoff. Please respond with: "approve expedited cutover". Also provide rollback metric + cmd.

ops-lead: I approve expedited cutover for eu-west1. Rollback trigger: 502 > 3% sustained for 5m. Rollback cmd preloaded.

product: +1 from product; customers impacted.

ci-bot: Note: image c0ffee11 passed signed-scans.

ops-oncall: Rollback cmd: ```kubectl rollout undo deploy/embeddings -n prod --to-revision=stable-2026-03-21``` Watching dashboards.

sam: approve expedited cutover :thumbsup: I'll monitor traces.

nora: Kicking off deploy now.

deploybot: Executing expedited rollout to eu-west1: batch-size=100% override, timeout=10m. Logs: "pulling c0ffee11 -> spinning new pods"

ops-oncall: 2m: error rate down to 9%, p50 latency ~330ms.

deploybot: 6m checkpoint: readiness 96%, healthchecks OK.

sam: Traces look clean, embeddings samples pass smoke checks.

ops-oncall: 10m: final: 1.8% 502s, p50 190ms. No new alerts.

deploybot: Emergency window closed. Please post a short entry to #release-notes and file a quick RCA ticket.

nora: Drafting release note: "hotfix eu-west1: swap to stable-model-v4 to mitigate 502s; tightened worker timeouts." Will post shortly.

ops-lead: Add CI gating for model promotions to prevent regressions.

product: Thanks team.

nora: Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
